expectation: Membrane/cytoplasmic rings on macrophages, a subset of CD68+/IBA1+ cells; moderately common. In gut mucosa: scattered single cells in the villus lamina propria and the submucosa, sitting on IBA1+ cells; absent from epithelium and muscle.
notes: Membrane-ring cells sit in the mucosal lamina propria, and in E1 faint CD163 outlines follow the IBA1 network. The brightest spots (B, D) are blobs, and fine grain covers the muscle layer, so contrast is low.
observed: A: dots in villus cores, plus speckle over the muscular wall. B: ring-shaped cells at top left, one bright blob below. C: a single speck. D: an irregular bright blob. E1/E3: faint membranous rings on part of the IBA1 cells; the merge is mostly magenta.
why: A specific population of ring-stained cells sits in the lamina propria on IBA1+ cells, but it shows at low contrast against grain and bright debris.
